items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: they would bring people in like Della Reese and Johnny Mathis

ctx.x: So when was the first time that you did one of these? Or had you been doing some of these to fill in all along?

Well, I was..oh I was at the Elegante..oh I forgot about that, that's in Ocean Park between Avenue J and K and I was there in the lounge.* And this was the type of place where they would bring people in like Della Reese and Johnny Mathis and try 'em out and then they'd send 'em to the Copa. That was the type of thing. But I was in the lounge with Shorty Allen, who wrote "The Rock and Roll Waltz", yeah. And Shorty Allen was a nice person. And I staid there. Maurice Mark played there sometimes, then sometimes…
